3652-5006-5147-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
3652-5006-5147-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ornithopter, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5147-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5147-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

5702-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, either creating a 1/1 green Insect creature token or causing you to pay {1}{G} and create a copy of the creature enchanted by Springheart Nantuko
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4279-6887-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6887-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

549-2511-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-2511-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat from step 3.
549-2511-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

1456-5078-7295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1856-4247-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: Doom Weaver paired with the persist creature.
1856-4247-6249--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver ability, pairing it with the persist creature.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from the persist creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

549-1274-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-1274-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4013-7505.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Patagia Viper.
When Patagia Viper enters, its first and second ability trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4013-7505.notes: Do not resolve Patagia Viper's second trigger. Resolve the first, sacrifice the tokens, and then repeat with the second trigger still on the stack.

4871-5147-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4871-5147-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield and doesn't have summoning sickness.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander that doesn't have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5434-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

628-5231-7212.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

480-5147-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

3025-5073-5220-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

32-2468.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Temporal Trespass without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Trespass, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

856-4321-5256-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5256-5632.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

141-5686-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-5686-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

101-372-1922.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-1922.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3668-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Flesh Duplicate has a power of at least 2.
1912-3668-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Flesh Duplicate and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Flesh Duplicate from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Flesh Duplicate to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Flesh Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Flesh Duplicate by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

64-1987-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
64-1987-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-1170-3105-5293.description:
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library and/or graveyard for Rite of Flame and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Pyretic Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Rite of Flame by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pyretic Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Rite of Flame, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

803-1821-3000.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Phyrexian" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1821-3000.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature entes the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Arcane Adaptation, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat step 2.

132-2645-3053.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control if Staff of Domination is exiled, or five basic land types otherwise.
132-2645-3053.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
If Staff of Domination is exiled, activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Otherwise, activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Myr Welder. Then, activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-3053.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1429-4419-5256.description:
Sacrifice the Lesser Masticore to Altar of Dementia to mill target player 2.
Lesser Masticore returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter.
The counters cancel out.
Repeat.
